blocks.text: The RCCG has a ministerial structure and mode of operation that enables it to harness its God-given resources and sustain the pace of growth it has seen. From the top of the structure down, the chain runs as follows:

items: Assistant National Elder / Special Assistant to the General Overseer
Pastor in Charge of Region / Regional Evangelist / Secretary
Pastor in Charge of Province / Assistant Secretary
Assistant Pastor in Charge of Province / Church Growth Officer 1

blocks.text: The local Parish (alongside House Fellowship Centres) is the lowest rung of the RCCG's ministerial structure, and every policy begins at this level. A Local Parish is administered by a Pastor-in-Charge, supported by other ordained and non-ordained ministers.

For ease of administration, each local assembly is segmented into departments, giving rise to Heads of Departments who share the overall work of church administration with the Pastor-in-Charge. The reporting line runs from the Pastor-in-Charge (Pastors, Assistant Pastors, Deacons, Deaconesses, and un-ordained ministers) to the Heads of Departments (Deacons and Deaconesses, Assistant Pastors, non-ordained ministers, and workers) and the ordained and un-ordained altar ministers.
